E2391

Project check could not prove the Core closure: {detail}

What

Project check could not prove the Core closure: {detail}

Why

The selected Core calls and synthesized Prelude closure must be known before a project can be reported clean.

Fix

Repair the Core route or compiler defect named by the proof, then run jet check again.
